description: This Java class defines an event named FeaturePropertyCreated, emitted after a property of a feature within a thing is created. It includes methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and retrieving event details.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a created property of a feature within a thing, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new FeaturePropertyCreated instance with detailed parameters including thing ID, feature ID, property pointer, value, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertyCreated instance from a JSON string or object, parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature associated with this event.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the created property.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the created property.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a copy of this event with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of this event with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends event payload data into a JSON object builder based on schema version and predicate.
